title.original: Declarative Data Pipeline for Large Scale ML Services
title.zh: 面向大规模机器学习服务的声明式数据流水线
title.en: Declarative Data Pipeline for Large Scale ML Services

inclusion_reason.zh: DDP 的声明式 Pipes、标准接口和 Spark 内执行层构成可复用的大规模 ML 数据处理架构，而非单一应用管线。
inclusion_reason.en: DDP's declarative Pipes, standardized interfaces, and in-Spark execution layer form a reusable large-scale ML data architecture rather than a one-off application pipeline.

abstract.zh: Declarative Data Pipeline 在 Apache Spark 内以 Pipes 作为逻辑计算单元，把机器学习处理组合成声明式、模块化的超大规模数据流水线。
abstract.en: Declarative Data Pipeline composes machine-learning processing inside Apache Spark through logical units called Pipes, providing a declarative and modular path for very large data workloads.

problem.zh: 在多人协作的大规模机器学习服务中，微服务式拆分会增加接口、通信和协调成本，性能优化又容易破坏代码可维护性。
problem.en: In collaborative ML services, microservice-style decomposition adds interface, communication, and coordination overhead, while performance tuning can erode maintainability.

approach.zh: 作者用标准化边界定义可组合的 Pipes，让执行引擎在不暴露分布式细节的情况下统一编排数据转换和模型相关计算。
approach.en: The authors define composable Pipes with standardized boundaries so the engine can orchestrate data transformations and model-related computation without exposing distributed details to every component.

system_design.zh: 开发者声明 Pipes 及其依赖，框架在 Spark 内构建逻辑流水线、优化执行并管理组件间数据流，避免为每个阶段部署独立服务。
system_design.en: Developers declare Pipes and dependencies; the framework builds and optimizes the logical pipeline within Spark and manages inter-component data flow without deploying a service per stage.

key_results.zh: 企业案例显示该架构在开发协作、可扩展性和吞吐量上均优于原有方案，并能处理十亿级记录。
key_results.en: Enterprise cases report improvements in development collaboration, scalability, and throughput over the prior design while processing workloads at billion-record scale.

limitations.zh: 证据主要来自特定企业和 Spark 技术栈，缺少独立复现；收益可能依赖既有组织结构、工作负载形态和迁移基线。
limitations.en: Evidence comes mainly from a specific enterprise and the Spark stack without independent replication; gains may depend on organizational structure, workload shape, and the migration baseline.

workloads: enterprise processing of billions of records

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件、基线和指标均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未披露的表格明细、硬件拓扑与集群配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; undisclosed table details, hardware topology, and cluster configuration still require full-text audit.
